verses.verse:
नाऽहम् वसामि बैकुण्ठे योगिनाम् हृदये न च।
मद् भक्ता यत्र गायन्ति तत्र तिष्ठामि नारद।१२८।
verses.text: I do not dwell in Vaikuṇṭha, nor in the hearts of yogīs; where my devotees sing, there I abide, O Nārada.

commentary.text: That is, the Lord says with his own blessed mouth: "O Nārada, I do not live in Vaikuṇṭha, nor do I live in the hearts of yogīs; I live where my devotees, absorbed, sing my praises."

following.text: Here ends the Sādhanā Prakaraṇa (chapter on practice)
In the sādhanā (practice) section above, the method of ālāpa and layālāpa of rāgas has been described. Now, going on from layālāpa, we are going to consider the method of rāgas bound in tāla.
Now begins the Pradarśana Prakaraṇa (chapter on performance)
